name: noor
description: The Noor client format, recovered column-for-column from Park_Gate_Residences_-Noor_standardised.xlsx. Eleven columns; SIZE in square metres. See ADR-005.
_columns_note: FLAT  carries a trailing space because the client's file does. Templates
reproduce the client's format, quirks included.
FLOOR is not one of the 23 canonical fields and is emitted blank until a
decision is made on whether it becomes one (ADR-005, open question).
SIZE: canonical storage is square feet. The client wants square metres. The
conversion is declared here, on both sides, or it does not happen.
_dedup_note: This is a DECLARED rule. It does NOT reproduce the historical Park Gate
delivery: no tested key reproduces its 434 rows (ADR-005). The summary
reports counts under this rule by name and never claims to match history.
